name: Manziana (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and green (drawn as teal), charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Manziana (a bull on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Manziana, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Manziana arms — bull on blue, crowned, within branches
